en_title: Resident Evil Director Knows RE2 Didn't Have Snow or iPhones, But He 'Took Liberties' to Make the Movie Better
cn_title: 《生化危机》导演回应雪景与iPhone争议
subtitle: 改设定只为拍出更好的电影

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has seen all the comments about the snow and iPhones in his new movie, but he said he's got a good reason for why he "took liberties" with the lore.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》电影导演扎克·克雷格已经看到了所有关于新片中雪景和iPhone的评论，但他表示，自己对原作设定「自由发挥」是有充分理由的。

paragraphs.en: Cregger has spent some of his time at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) 2026 celebrating the release of his movie's new trailer. He's also used his presence at the show to talk more about why his version of the Raccoon City Incident looks different from what fans of games like Resident Evil 2 and 3 might have expected.
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格在2026年圣迭戈国际动漫展（SDCC）期间，一边庆祝影片新预告发布，一边进一步解释了为何他笔下的浣熊市事件，与《生化危机2》和《生化危机3》等游戏粉丝预想的不太一样。

paragraphs.en: "I take liberties," he told IGN . "It's not 1998. It takes place in modern times. I know that, during the events of Resident Evil 2, it's not snowing, and yet, in this movie, I thought it would be better for the story and for the visual, you know, whatever I'm doing, if it was snowy. It's going to be a better movie for it.
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉IGN：「我的确做了自由改编。故事不是发生在1998年，而是在现代。我知道《生化危机2》的事件发生时并没有下雪，但在这部电影里，我觉得雪景能让故事和视觉效果更好——不管我具体在做什么——影片也会因此变得更出色。」

paragraphs.en: "I am not trying to adapt a video game. I'm not using the characters from the games. I'm not telling a story that the games tell because I'm not going to be able to do it better than the games. The games are so well executed, and to me, Leon and Claire and these characters, they exist so perfectly in the games that anyone I cast and any difference that I do with them would be, probably, to the detriment of what I was trying to do."
paragraphs.cn: 「我不是要把某一款游戏直接改编成电影，也不会使用游戏中的角色，更不会重述游戏已经讲过的故事，因为我不可能比游戏做得更好。那些游戏完成得太出色了。对我而言，里昂、克莱尔等角色在游戏中已经如此完美，无论我找谁来演，或对他们作出任何改动，都很可能损害我想完成的作品。」

paragraphs.en: Most fans would agree; mixing the director behind Barbarian and Weapons into the Resident Evil universe feels like a recipe for success. Although the premiere of its first trailer largely kept the hype momentum going, it's also safe to say it's picked up a few critics along the way.
paragraphs.cn: 多数粉丝大概都会同意，让《野蛮人》和《凶器》的导演进入《生化危机》宇宙，看起来很有成功潜力。首支预告亮相后，影片的热度基本延续了下来，但同时也招来了一些批评。

paragraphs.en: Some were quick to point out that, while the original lore saw the Raccoon City Incident take place in the late '90s in a rainy town on the brink of destruction, Cregger's film seemed to be set in a more modern, wintry timeline. Despite a plethora of references to elements and moments that should feel familiar to fans, the criticism from the more skeptical watchers has only simmered the last few months.
paragraphs.cn: 有人很快指出，原作中的浣熊市事件发生在20世纪90年代末，地点是一座阴雨连绵、濒临毁灭的小城；克雷格的电影却像是设定在更现代、寒冷多雪的时间线上。尽管片中有大量粉丝熟悉的元素和场景，持怀疑态度的观众在过去几个月里仍不断提出批评。

paragraphs.en: Cregger has already spent the time leading up to the Resident Evil movie proclaiming his love for games like Resident Evil 2 and 4, while also doing his best to calm uneasy watchers . Now, he's doing his best to put fears to rest entirely.
paragraphs.cn: 在电影上映前的宣传期里，克雷格一直强调自己对《生化危机2》和《生化危机4》等游戏的热爱，也尽力安抚心存不安的观众。如今，他希望彻底打消大家的疑虑。

paragraphs.en: "It's kind of like when you have your favorite book, and then you find out someone is turning your favorite book into a movie, and then you hear who they cast, and you're always like, 'Not that. No. That's not what I want.' I'm not trying to do that," Cregger explained. "What I'm trying to do is make a Resident Evil movie that really is a love letter to the experience of playing a Resident Evil game. To me, that means a couple of different things."
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格解释道：「这就像你有一本最喜欢的书，后来听说有人要把它拍成电影，再听到选角时，你总会想：『不是这样。不，这不是我想要的。』我并不打算做那种事。我要拍的是一部真正向《生化危机》游戏体验致敬的电影。对我来说，这包含几个不同层面。」

paragraphs.en: He said his vision for a Resident Evil movie needs things like the T-Virus, Umbrella Corporation, and Raccoon City. Pieces of the puzzle like this are "necessary," which is why, instead of seeing Leon quip one-liners with star Austin Abrams, fans are far more likely to see that classic red-and-white logo pop up.
paragraphs.cn: 他表示，自己设想中的《生化危机》电影必须包含T病毒、保护伞公司和浣熊市等元素。这些拼图是「必不可少的」。因此，比起看到里昂和主演奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯互相抖机灵，粉丝更可能在片中见到那个经典的红白标志。

paragraphs.en: "They're in there, but the most important thing I'm trying to do is make a movie that feels like it's unraveling the way that, when you play the game, it's unfolding," Cregger continued. "To me, that means a couple of different things. It's about one character moving on foot from point A to point B, moving from set piece to set piece, location to location .
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格继续说道：「这些元素都在片中，但我最想做到的，是让电影像玩家亲自游玩时那样逐步展开。对我而言，这意味着几件事：一个角色徒步从A点走到B点，从一个大型场景转向下一个，从一处地点前往另一处。」

paragraphs.en: "Every location has its own unique threat, right? You have to keep in mind resource management and your health. You're wounded, and you feel like you never have enough ammunition, and the world is always too big for you, and yet somehow, you've got to make it through, right? That's what I'm trying to do."
paragraphs.cn: 「每个地点都有独特的威胁，对吧？你必须时刻考虑资源管理和自己的生命值。你受了伤，总觉得弹药永远不够，整个世界又大得令你无力应对，但无论如何，你还是得设法撑过去，对吧？这正是我想做的。」

paragraphs.en: The most recent Resident Evil movie trailer showed more of Abrams' courier character while teasing some of the other connections to the wider universe . Like the first clip, it had its fans and its critics, as the footage reminded viewers of its modern settings and lore tweaks. Cregger has said that, when the film finally premieres, those who are most familiar with the series should feel right at home.
paragraphs.cn: 最新一版《生化危机》电影预告展示了更多艾布拉姆斯饰演的快递员角色，同时暗示影片与整个系列宇宙的其他联系。和首支片段一样，这段影像既有人喜欢，也有人批评，因为它再次让观众注意到现代背景和设定改动。克雷格表示，等影片正式上映时，最熟悉该系列的观众应该会感到十分亲切。

paragraphs.en: "It's like, if this movie was a Resident Evil game, call it Resident Evil 10, it wouldn't feel weird. You know what I mean? That's what I'm trying to build."
paragraphs.cn: 「打个比方，如果这部电影是一款《生化危机》游戏，就算把它叫作《生化危机10》，你也不会觉得奇怪。明白我的意思吗？这就是我想打造的效果。」

paragraphs.en: Cregger finalized his response to concerned fans by saying he gets why so many are upset. Resident Evil means so much to so many people, and the franchise's movies have mostly strayed from the source material, but that's why this movie will blend its lore with the true feel of a survival horror adventure.
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格最后表示，他理解为何许多粉丝感到不满。《生化危机》对很多人意义重大，而该系列此前的电影大多偏离原作。也正因如此，这部新片会把系列设定与真正的生存恐怖冒险体验结合起来。

paragraphs.en: "I get the instinct to dig in," Cregger said. "I'll be honest: I've never seen a Resident Evil movie because they don't look, to me, like what I love so much about the games that I play. I was just like, 'Not my Resident Evil.' So, I understand that attitude. I'm making this because I want a movie to exist that feels like the experience of playing the game, and so, I was able to do that. That's what I'm doing."
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格说：「我理解大家坚持己见的本能。坦白讲，我从没看过任何一部《生化危机》电影，因为在我看来，它们不像我所热爱的那些游戏。我当时的反应就是：『这不是我的《生化危机》。』所以我理解这种态度。我拍这部电影，是因为我希望世上能有一部真正具有游戏游玩体验的电影，而我得以把它实现。这就是我正在做的事。」

paragraphs.en: Cregger's Resident Evil movie comes to theaters September 18, 2026. While we wait for Cregger to share more, you can check out why a completely different group of fans went after the trailer . You can also read about how Abrams almost met an untimely fate on set .
paragraphs.cn: 克雷格执导的《生化危机》电影将于2026年9月18日登陆影院。在等待他公布更多消息期间，你可以了解为何另一群粉丝也对预告表达不满，以及艾布拉姆斯如何险些在片场遭遇致命意外。

summary: 《生化危机》导演扎克·克雷格回应新片雪景、iPhone和现代背景引发的争议，称这些改动服务于故事与视觉效果；影片不会照搬游戏剧情，而是忠实还原资源匮乏、步步受困的生存恐怖体验。
opus_summary: 扎克·克雷格承认《生化危机》新片改动了年代和天气，却强调自己不是照搬游戏剧情，而是要把资源管理、弹药不足和险境求生的游玩感搬上银幕。
